name: Linker Hand L30 Pro
name_zh: Linker Hand L30 Pro 灵巧手
summary: Linker Hand L30 Pro is LinkerBot's tendon-driven dexterous hand for research and complex robotic manipulation. Its 22 total degrees of freedom comprise 18 active and four passive axes. The manufacturer combines a bionic tendon structure with integrated control and sensing, emphasizing rapid finger motion and responsive manipulation. The specification lists an approximately 1.2 kg mass, CAN FD communication and a 0.2-second opening or closing time. It belongs to the tendon-driven branch of the Linker Hand range, so linkage- and direct-drive model specifications should not be substituted.
